text: Iran War: American President Trump Declares Epic Fury Victory; Reveals Next 3-Week US Action PlanU.S. President Donald Trump, in his national address, outlined key takeaways while projecting Operation Epic Fury as a major success. He termed it a full-scale victory pitch, detailing its objectives, progress so far, and the United States’ plans for the next two to three weeks.
